migrations.description: Canonical article-feed vocabulary: the ArticleList block and the blog-index template name the same feed controls the same way (WP-12).

Canonical mediaSide: four spellings of "which side is the media on" become one fragment-owned vocabulary (left/right/above/below). Dormant until the block schemas adopt the media-side fragment (WP-09R bumps schemaVersion to 1.3.0); the value maps are exhaustive over each block's legacy options, so anything outside them is a value no schema ever offered and falls to the default tiers.

changes.note: "none" is not a side, it is "no media" — mapping it into the side vocabulary would either pollute every adopter with an option most cannot render, or silently turn a card that hides its image into one that shows it. It splits: the card keeps its side (right, the block default) and hides the media through the companion showMedia flag WP-09R adds to the schema.

hint.en-US: Your blocks and nothing else — no brand frame, no site chrome. Social posts, OG images, ads, anything with a cut-out edge.
hint.it: Solo i tuoi blocchi, senza cornice del brand né elementi del sito. Ideale per post social, immagini OG e annunci.

hint.en-US: Adds the theme's canvas frame and accent line. Designed at 1440px wide and shrunk to fit smaller canvases. No site header or footer is ever rendered.
hint.it: Aggiunge la cornice e la linea distintiva del tema. Si adatta ai canvas più piccoli senza mostrare intestazione o piè di pagina.

label.en-US: Branded canvas — scales up for large prints

hint.en-US: The branded sheet, allowed to scale up to 4× so a 1440px design fills a large sheet. Posters, banners, print.
hint.it: Il foglio con brand può essere ingrandito fino a 4× per poster, banner e materiali stampati.
